_comment: Accepted dependency-audit findings. Each entry needs a reason and an expiry date (YYYY-MM-DD); .github/scripts/audit-gate.mjs fails the build once an entry expires. Never add an advisory that has a fix available.

entries.reason: Stack exhaustion on deeply nested glob patterns. Reached only through the `shadcn` CLI (the storefront imports just its static tailwind.css), which globs the developer's own files; it is never loaded by the running site and no request data reaches it. No patched `braces` release exists yet (3.0.3 is the latest), and the suggested `npm audit fix --force` would downgrade shadcn to 1.0.0. Re-check when braces publishes a fix, and consider moving `shadcn` to devDependencies.
